info.name: Job Portal Backend API
info.description:
Complete test suite for the Job Portal REST API.

HOW TO RUN
1. Start MongoDB and the API (npm run dev)
2. Create the admin once: npm run seed:admin
3. Import this collection (and the environment file), then open Collection Runner and run ALL folders IN ORDER.

The requests are ordered on purpose: each folder logs in as a different user (the JWT lives in an httpOnly cookie that Postman stores automatically).

exec: // A fresh run id keeps emails unique every time you run the collection
pm.test("Password / hash is not returned", function () { pm.expect(json.data.user).to.not.have.property("password"); });

request.description: Run before any login so the cookie jar is empty.

body.raw: "pm.test(\"Status code is 401\", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });\npm.test(\"Message mentions invalid token\", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include(\"Invalid token\"); });"

request.description: Sends a fake token. For an EXPIRED token test, set JWT_EXPIRES_IN=5s in .env, log in, wait, and call /api/auth/me - the API answers 'Your session has expired'.
